description: MCSA Magaliesberg Sheet 07 Castle Gorge. Ground truth from the 1-arc-minute graticule, measured independently of the core (fixtures/tools/measure_graticule.py): each line's position is the median, over 300 px segments along it, of the sub-pixel centroid of the thin dark graticule line where the paper around it is blank (map.jpg, 3507x4960 px, 300 dpi; the lines are axis-aligned: segment positions along each line agree to about 0.1 px). Values from the printed labels, read by eye. Labels (laid out as on Grootkloof): 25°47'00"S … 25°51'00"S printed vertically just inside the left frame, 27°34'00"E … 27°37'00"E along the bottom (27°34' runs into the 'GIS V1 Sept 2017 - Eras Gous' credit). Spacings 973.3-973.9 px per minute of latitude and 876.3 px per minute of longitude, as on Grootkloof; a Web Mercator fit of each axis leaves residuals under 0.05 px. Map frame as on Grootkloof (double frame lines at x 106/118 and 3388/3400, y 106/118 and 4841/4853). Contour colour: median of the brown contour line pixels.
